title: Chapter 640
paragraphs: Chapter 640
Episode 164. Land of the Monstrosity (2)
The soft purple light enveloping Lionel's body was fading.
His soul was leaving. Lionel's body, devoid of its soul, became grotesque and dark like any other chaos mass.
The soul moved toward the ghost tomb like a wind. Jin guessed this was the key to summon Lionel again in the future and immediately swung his spirit sword.
Although a definite sensation was felt when the blade made contact, as if slicing through human flesh, the soul continued its return even as it was torn apart.
Lionel will appear again.
However, the immediate problem was not Lionel, but the owner of the new energy leaking from the ghost tomb.
'This energy...'
A blue force, like the aura of a monarch, was revealing itself from that distant chaos.
The energy of a great knight from the ten great knights that Jin had seen in Thémar's tomb in the past.
Paddler Runcandel.
The second knight summoned from the ghost tomb was him.
He also had a body glowing with a soft purple light, like Lionel. There seemed to be some kind of difference between ordinary chaos summons, Lionel, and Paddler.

-Knight of the Ten Great Knights, Paddler Runcandel. I have enjoyed infinite glory having received the name Runcandel from the head of the house. From now on, I will make amends even in death for attacking the head of the house.
As soon as he saw Paddler, the words he had spoken in the record device came to mind.
One of the two knights who went with Murakan a thousand years ago when he decided to kill Thémar, who was being consumed by chaos in the Tower of the Black Sea.
Jin did not know much about Paddler.
He had only seen a few fragmentary aspects of him in the record device left by Solderet.
But one thing was certain.
Paddler should never have been standing here now.

To begin with, none of the ten great knights were laid to rest in the ghost tomb. Not only in the ghost tomb, but also anywhere in the Sword Garden, their stories could not be found. Because Jifle had erased all their history.
All of the Ten Great Knights Jin had met so far had been protectors of Thémar's tomb, fighting a lonely war for a long time.
-(I found the relic of the first head of the house, Thémar Runcandel, in the Sword Garden. No specific announcement, but a strong will to recover the forgotten history of the house.)
A sentence that suddenly came to Jin's mind.
'The fifth tomb of Thémar... Sir Paddler was probably guarding it.'
The prophet is using Paddler, who was the guardian of the fifth tomb.
Either the house reached the tomb before Valeria, or they attacked her when she discovered the tomb and obtained it. Either way, Jin felt his heart rotting.
As Paddler approached, the bodies of Ran, Buega, Myu, and An, who had been pushed far away by the aftermath of the battle, were being disintegrated into particles.
Their particles seemed to be flowing into Paddler. They had become the materials to summon Paddler.
However, Jin didn't consider it as their death.
"...Sir Paddler Runcandel. You may not know me, but I know you."
[No, I do know you. Jin Runcandel, the 12th generation of the current Runcandel. Ilina told me about you.]
"What did they say about me?"
[A person resembling Thémar Runcandel, who was my lord.]
"I have often heard that assessment."
[But I barely have any memories about him.]
"I thought I could hear the stories of those times, it's a pity. Then, the reason you're blocking me now... is it for Runcandel?"
Paddler looked surprised, as if he heard something strange, and shook his head.
[Jin Runcandel. Could you fight for him after you dedicated your kingdom, your body, and your life to someone you admire, and were betrayed...?]
Jin didn't answer and locked eyes with Paddler. Black tears, like dead blood, were flowing from his eyes.
[The only thing I remember about Thémar Runcandel is that in the end, he destroyed my kingdom, Ithal, not leaving a speck of dust or any life, with his own hands.]
Paddler Runcandel.
He was not originally a pure-blooded Runcandel. Like Silderay, he was inspired by Thémar and received the name Runcandel.
His real name is Paddler Ithal.

A genius of the era who was the king of the Ithal Kingdom, a magic swordsman called 'Blue Thunder King' that existed a thousand years ago, who completed a perfect magic sword, which was considered unique to Runcandel.
Jin could not tell whether Paddler's words were true, false, or manipulated history.
However, it seemed impossible to dispel the full hatred within him with any words.
[What I want is not the revival of Runcandel, but corruption and ruin. The power your mother, Rosa Runcandel, the descendant of Thémar, chose will eventually plunge Runcandel into the abyss.]
"Before I met you, I met Sir Silderay and Lady Sarah in Thémar's tomb. Precisely, they were guardians created from souls. Also, I've seen them talking with you in Solderet's record device. They..."
[You want to say they were different from me? Therefore, you want to force me to sacrifice?]
A smirk formed on Paddler's face.
"Do you remember them?"
[No. I can't remember, and I don't want to.]
Swoosh...
As Paddler slowly drew his sword. 'Silus', the sword that symbolized his clarity a thousand years ago, was radiating a blue light.
The sword, at least, was not made of chaos or souls, but the very object that existed a thousand years ago.
[My purpose in defeating you today is solely revenge against Temar and the sole reason for my existence as a demon. I have no personal feelings towards you.]
"I don't know everything about what happened a thousand years ago, Sir Paddler. And what I wanted to say by mentioning the names of Sir Silderei and Sir Sarah was not that you should resemble them."
Jin closed his eyes tightly once.
"……I simply wanted to say that they seemed to care for each other very much. It would probably be before the fall of the Idal kingdom in your memory."
-[I killed all those things before you came. Ah, exactly, I swept them away with Paddler. You're late again, bastard. Where have you been goofing off this time?]
-[Paddler got a little hurt. I'm fine as always, but I guess you or the owner should train that weak bone.]
-Can't you stop using expressions like melting in humans?
-Human refers only to those who are not enemies of Runcandel, weak bone. You know that, don't be silly.
-Still, it doesn't seem good for your emotions.
-Am I a teenage girl? Take care of your health instead of caring about my feelings.
The conversations they heard when they encountered Guardian Sarah and in the recording device.
Sarah and Paddler seemed to have a particularly special relationship. So much so that it felt close to lovers beyond mere colleagues.
However, Paddler now showed no emotion even when looking at the remnants of Up-Hwa scattered around.
Jin, opening his eyes again, lifted Bradamante.
It was entirely possible to unfold Up-Hwa again. Although his energy was drained from the previous battle, it was not difficult at all.
However, it was too cruel to cut Paddler with the sword she had left behind.
Even considering Sarah, who woke up after a thousand years and mentioned Paddler's name first, no matter what circumstances Jin didn't know.
[A once harmonious heart can't replace all of me that has disappeared.]
Jin nodded bitterly.
"The reason I cut you today goes beyond distinguishing between truth and falsehood...... I think it's for you. Please don't forgive the inevitable choice of an incompetent descendant."
Paddler clearly died a thousand years ago.
The life of the dead awakened by chaos is filled only with hollow hatred.
The only thing Jin could do for Paddler was to stop that time like a broken wagon being forced to move.
[Indeed, you make arrogant comments like Temar. With that exhausted body, you dare to cut me down......]
As he said, Paddler was not a person Jin could handle alone when tired.
One of the Ten Knights, who were the strongest, and always fought alongside Sarah. The meaning of that fact was simple.
A comrade whom Sarah, often mentioned as the strongest of the Ten Knights, could trust the most. Even if his physical condition was normal, he could not guarantee it.
"Also, please do not forgive me for not being able to handle you alone."
Spiritual energy wrapped around Bradamante.
Spirit Sword Special Style
Summoning Black Light
The black blade of Bradamante cut through the emptiness filled with chaos. As always, following the trail of the blade, a black door leading to Lafrarosa opened.
Jin was tense.
To suppress Paddler as quickly as possible, if he wanted help in the ensuing battles and escape, the Two Kings brothers must be summoned.
It would certainly be a big help even if the regular soldiers were summoned, but too much was at stake in the battle with Paddler.
Fortunately, seeing the summoned brothers, Jin sighed with relief internally.
A giant bow, a great bow, 'Shinsal', sparking lightning, so big it was unbelievable that it was a weapon used by humans.
The Twelve King of the Ming Dynasty, Kaio. He was emerging from the dimension door of the Summoning Black Light.
"I'm sorry for calling you, Brother Kaio."
"Brother Jin, are you saying that the moment you need the power of other brothers has already come even after becoming the Two Kings?"
Kaio seemed to speak gruffly, but after Jin left, he had been hoping for this moment to come sooner than anyone else.
Because, just as Jin still felt sorry for him, so did Kaio.
Even if brothers don't count favors.
"Anyway, this is how it feels to be chosen. I am Kaio, the Twelve King of the great Ming Dynasty. Since I came out into the world at the call of my brother, name your enemy."
Kaio suddenly stopped speaking.
He had recognized Paddler's energy, which was very similar to the energy of the Ming Dynasty.
"A human who uses power similar to ours...... Could it possibly be a descendant of the man called the King of Clarity, a comrade of Temar?"
